mandatory_design_decision.decision: Keep the public UrlService(UrlRepository) constructor, annotate it with @org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired, and delegate to this(repository, java.time.Clock.systemUTC()). Add public UrlService(UrlRepository, java.time.Clock), store a private final Clock, and use java.time.Instant.now(clock) for both creation validation and redirect expiration checks. Use fixed UTC in additive GeneratedExpirationBoundaryTest; existing tests and build remain unchanged.
mandatory_design_decision.rationale: Deterministic equality-boundary testing without altering HTTP 201/400/404/410, optional expiration, redirects, or click behavior.

details.required_correction: Retain @Autowired on public UrlService(UrlRepository repository); its body must delegate with this(repository, java.time.Clock.systemUTC()). Retain the explicit repository/Clock constructor and all other approved behavior.
